writers.name: Ottoline Vex
writers.tagline: Thirty years in the Senate Chamber gallery. Still unimpressed.

writers.name: Barnaby Tallowmere
writers.tagline: Inventor of the Loaf Index. Has not slept since the last rate hike.
writers.bio: Barnaby Tallowmere kept the books for a Shire bakery until he noticed bread was getting more expensive and could not stop noticing. He now tracks the economy entirely through the Loaf Index, the price of one honest loaf of bread in copper pieces, and worries about it professionally.

writers.name: Sterling Vanmoor
writers.tagline: Every catastrophe is a market opportunity. Ask him how.
writers.bio: Sterling Vanmoor has founded eleven ventures, nine of which he describes as 'learning experiences' and two of which are under investigation by the Royal Inquisitors. He covers the Guilds with the unshakable optimism of a man who has never personally been eaten by a mimic.
writers.signoff: — Sterling Vanmoor, Guild Visionary. Let's connect at the Yawning Portal.

writers.name: Brakka Stonesweat
writers.tagline: Forty years in the shafts. Not a single one of them paid enough.
writers.bio: Brakka Stonesweat swung a pick in the Mithral Hall deeps for forty years and organized her first strike at age nineteen. She covers labor because somebody has to say what the guildmasters won't, and because her knees no longer allow mining.
writers.signoff: Solidarity. And stretch your back. — Brakka

writers.name: Hollis Delvewright
writers.tagline: Eleven years holding the torch for adventurers. Now she holds a quill, and they still won't split the loot.
writers.bio: Hollis Delvewright carried torches for nine adventuring parties, four of which still exist. She walked out of her last dungeon with a notebook full of things nobody else had written down and a ten-foot pole she refuses to return. The Gazette sends her wherever the realm is on fire, flooded, cursed, or being tunneled into.

realm.blurb: A small mountain town of Montanor, where the whole populace gathers whenever a large beast does something unusual.

articles.title: Bull Moose Trapped in Skate Park; Wardens Cast Sleep

realm.name: Fatehaven
realm.blurb: A sandy coastal town on the Floridian shore, known for its white beaches and its view of whatever comes over the water.

articles.title: Hurricane Isleias Darkens 884,000 Hearths; Cold Soup Advised

realm.name: the Montanor Wardens of Wood, Fang & Fen
realm.blurb: The provincial rangers who look after Montanor's forests, beasts and bogs, and who keep a very large sleep dart for emergencies.

articles.title: Bull Moose Trapped in Skate Park; Wardens Cast Sleep

realm.name: Gorgonia
realm.blurb: A peach-orchard province of Waterdeep to the north of the Floridian swamps, watched warily by its neighbors for what the weather sends up from the south.

articles.title: Hurricane Isleias Darkens 884,000 Hearths; Cold Soup Advised

realm.name: Alabaster
realm.blurb: A southern province of Waterdeep with pale chalk cliffs, deep roots, and plenty of rain when the storms roll in.

articles.title: Hurricane Isleias Darkens 884,000 Hearths; Cold Soup Advised

realm.name: Hellroarer Skate Bowl
realm.blurb: A deep concrete bowl in Red Lodgepole where local youths practice their tricks on enchanted skates. Not designed for antlers.

articles.title: Bull Moose Trapped in Skate Park; Wardens Cast Sleep

realm.name: Montanor
realm.blurb: A mountainous western province of Waterdeep, famed for big sky, bigger beasts, and towns small enough that everyone turns up to a rescue.

articles.title: Bull Moose Trapped in Skate Park; Wardens Cast Sleep

realm.name: South Tryst Street
realm.blurb: A main avenue of Carlotta's Ford, wide enough for carts and, as it turns out, couches.

articles.title: Watch Pulls Over Two Men Riding a Sofa on Enchanted Skates

realm.name: the Coalshire Reeve's Office
realm.blurb: The county reeve's office of Coalshire in Montanor, which keeps the peace and turns up to everything.

articles.title: Bull Moose Trapped in Skate Park; Wardens Cast Sleep

realm.name: Floridia
realm.blurb: A warm, flat, sun-struck peninsula province of Waterdeep, famous for its swamps, its retirees, and its storm season.

articles.title: Hurricane Isleias Darkens 884,000 Hearths; Cold Soup Advised

realm.name: the Bear's Citadel
realm.blurb: The frost-bound fortress in Damara where Czar Vlad the Bear-Handed holds court and where official statements are issued sparingly.

articles.title: Donwald Declares Energy Ceasefire; Damara Skips the Memo

realm.name: Carlotta's Ford
realm.blurb: A river-crossing trade city in the southern Realms, known for banking guilds, tall towers, and a fondness for odd processions.

articles.title: Watch Pulls Over Two Men Riding a Sofa on Enchanted Skates

realm.name: Royal Minister Sergei Lavroar
realm.blurb: Damara's longtime chief envoy abroad, known for delivering refusals in a low, steady growl.

articles.title: Donwald Declares Energy Ceasefire; Damara Skips the Memo

realm.name: Spokesman Dmitri Pestkoff
realm.blurb: Damara's court spokesman, whose standard answer to any question is that contacts are ongoing and he has nothing to add.

articles.title: Donwald Declares Energy Ceasefire; Damara Skips the Memo

realm.name: the Laurel Committee of Frostfell
realm.blurb: Five stern judges in a frozen northern hall who decide each autumn who has done the most for peace, and who never say who else was considered.

articles.title: Laurel Committee Passes Over Donwald an Eighth Time; Truthscroll Mobilizes

realm.name: Margrave Ronan DeSaintly of Floridia
realm.blurb: Margrave of Floridia, a stern and well-briefed ruler who likes a podium and a promise.

articles.title: Hurricane Isleias Darkens 884,000 Hearths; Cold Soup Advised

realm.name: Steward-General Shaun Fayne the Unbowed
realm.blurb: Head of the United Axlewrights, a plainspoken steward who spends more time on picket lines than in the guildmasters' parlors.

articles.title: Axlewrights' Union Election: Fayne Takes 68%, Keeps Seat

realm.name: Guildmaster Brynn Nickelcoin
realm.blurb: Guildmaster of Starbuck's Mystical Brews, and a former Guildmaster of Chipotlich Chult Grill. He is known for turnarounds, quick lunches and an unbothered smile.

articles.title: Coffee Guild Eyes 39B gp Burrito-Lich Takeover

realm.name: Court-Warden Neil Barrowsky
realm.blurb: The monitor the High Courts installed to watch the Axlewrights' books. Writes long, sharp reports and is not easily thanked.

articles.title: Axlewrights' Union Election: Fayne Takes 68%, Keeps Seat

realm.name: Vice-Steward Rich Boarer
realm.blurb: A senior officer of the Axlewrights who challenged the Steward-General and took a distant second.

articles.title: Axlewrights' Union Election: Fayne Takes 68%, Keeps Seat

realm.name: the Laurel Prize for Peace
realm.blurb: The most coveted honor in the realm for ending, preventing, or at least discussing wars, awarded each autumn in a cold northern hall.

articles.title: Laurel Committee Passes Over Donwald an Eighth Time; Truthscroll Mobilizes

realm.name: red-spot fever
realm.blurb: A highly contagious childhood fever marked by red spots, preventable with two doses of the pox-vial.

articles.title: Red-Spot Fever Tops 4,080 Cases as Disease Council Runs Short of Clerics

realm.name: the Royal Tally of Healths
realm.blurb: The realm's counting-house for births, illnesses and deaths, whose ledgers are kept in the capital.

articles.title: Red-Spot Fever Tops 4,080 Cases as Disease Council Runs Short of Clerics

realm.name: Squidditch
realm.blurb: A broomback ball game played at speed and altitude. Its professional league is better known for potion scandals than for its scores.

articles.title: Professional Squidditch League Doping Scandal Erupts

realm.name: Tempest Isleias
realm.blurb: The ninth named storm of the autumn season, a great wet beast that swelled over the Gulf waters and came ashore with a roar and a great deal of rain.

articles.title: Hurricane Isleias Darkens 884,000 Hearths; Cold Soup Advised

realm.name: the United Axlewrights
realm.blurb: The great union of cart-makers, wheel-menders and axle-fitters, who build the realm's carriages and have strong opinions about who profits from them.

articles.title: Axlewrights' Union Election: Fayne Takes 68%, Keeps Seat

realm.name: the Council of Realms
realm.blurb: The grand body where the realms' envoys meet to agree on statements and disagree on everything else.

articles.title: Laurel Committee Passes Over Donwald an Eighth Time; Truthscroll Mobilizes

realm.name: Nu Yarrow
realm.blurb: A populous, crowded eastern province of Waterdeep, famed for its towering guildhalls and its impatient citizens.

articles.title: Red-Spot Fever Tops 4,080 Cases as Disease Council Runs Short of Clerics

realm.name: Frostfell
realm.blurb: A cold northern realm of fjords and long winters, home to the hall where the Laurel Prize for Peace is decided.

articles.title: Laurel Committee Passes Over Donwald an Eighth Time; Truthscroll Mobilizes

realm.name: the World Siege
realm.blurb: The final autumn showdown of Major League Batball, in which two clubs besiege each other for the championship.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: Guildmaster Sam Altarman
realm.blurb: Guildmaster of OpenEye, who speaks softly about the future and carries a very large golem.

articles.title: OpenEye's New Golem Answers in Illusions, Charts, and Tiny Catapults

realm.name: Herald Katie Saccharia
realm.blurb: Newly appointed Herald of the Ivory Keep, hired straight from the High Lord's own scrying company. Her chief qualification, per the High Lord, is an unblemished record of support.

articles.title: Ivory Keep Names New Herald for Her Unblemished Record of Agreeing

realm.name: Herald Karoline Levitate
realm.blurb: Former Herald of the Ivory Keep and the youngest ever sworn in. Now a contributor at the Foxfire Tidings.

articles.title: Ivory Keep Names New Herald for Her Unblemished Record of Agreeing

realm.name: Guildmaster Jeff Bezoar
realm.blurb: Guildmaster of a vast mail-order caravan empire and owner of several rockets. Hands out business wisdom at galas whether or not anyone asked.

articles.title: Coffee Guild Eyes 39B gp Burrito-Lich Takeover

realm.name: the Vial Effects Ailment Register
realm.blurb: The crown's ledger where healers and commoners write down any ill effect they suspect came from a vial.

articles.title: Healing Minister Opens Infirmary to Hunt for Curses in Pox Vials

realm.name: Lord Steward J.D. Vantage
realm.blurb: Second-in-command to the High Lord, who speaks often about the plight of local workers and the dangers of foreign artisans.

articles.title: MicroScroll Barred From Hearth-Card Program: A Bold Pivot Toward Disruption

realm.name: Duke Volodar of Vaasa
realm.blurb: Duke of Vaasa and leader of its long defense against Damara. Tends to learn about ceasefires on his behalf from the newspapers.

articles.title: Donwald Declares Energy Ceasefire; Damara Skips the Memo

realm.name: Guildmaster Davyd Elfison
realm.blurb: Young Guildmaster of Skytrance Consolidated and heir to one of the largest fortunes in Waterdeep. Fond of buying studios.

articles.title: Skytrance Megamerger Closes, Bravely Rightsizes Hollowood's Adventuring Party

realm.name: Archcleric Jaybird Battlecharya
realm.blurb: Archcleric of the Noble Institutes of Healing, and a reliable presence at the Minister's ribbon-cuttings.

articles.title: Healing Minister Opens Infirmary to Hunt for Curses in Pox Vials

realm.name: Grand Almoner Mehmagus the Great and Powerful
realm.blurb: Grand Almoner of the Coffers of Medicine & Succor, formerly a crystal-ball showman who sold miracle tonics to the masses.

articles.title: Healing Minister Opens Infirmary to Hunt for Curses in Pox Vials

realm.name: High Cleric Errica Swartsword
realm.blurb: High Cleric of the Clerics' Disease Council, the realm's chief plague warden.

articles.title: Healing Minister Opens Infirmary to Hunt for Curses in Pox Vials

realm.name: Steward Annika Wallbreaker
realm.blurb: President of Lodge 1000, who says a clerk forced back to the office deserves the coin to get there.

articles.title: Golden Coast Clerks Call First Strike; Margrave Rolls for Initiative

realm.name: Larrion Elfison the Elder
realm.blurb: One of the richest wizards in Waterdeep, owner of many yachts, and father of the Guildmaster of Skytrance.

articles.title: Skytrance Megamerger Closes, Bravely Rightsizes Hollowood's Adventuring Party

realm.name: Co-Guildmaster Ynnon Kryse
realm.blurb: Co-Guildmaster of Skytrance Consolidated, formerly master of a toymaking guild famous for its dolls.

articles.title: Skytrance Megamerger Closes, Bravely Rightsizes Hollowood's Adventuring Party

realm.name: Margrave Gavin Newsoom of the Golden Coast
realm.blurb: Margrave of the Golden Coast. Very good hair, very firm opinions about where his clerks should sit.

articles.title: Golden Coast Clerks Call First Strike; Margrave Rolls for Initiative

realm.name: the Grand Assembly of Nations
realm.blurb: The yearly gathering where every realm's envoy gets a turn at the podium and nobody listens to anyone else's speech.

articles.title: Donwald Declares No Siege of Calimshan Until the Ballots Are Counted

realm.name: Kozakura
realm.blurb: An island realm off the eastern coast of Kara-Tur, known for its sluggers, its craftsmen, and its very punctual carriages.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: Hollowood
realm.blurb: The hillside district where spectacles, plays, and illusions are made for the whole realm.

articles.title: Skytrance Megamerger Closes, Bravely Rightsizes Hollowood's Adventuring Party

realm.name: the Hormoth Narrows
realm.blurb: A thin, much-fought-over sea passage that half the realm's lamp oil has to squeeze through. Whoever shuts it sets the price of everything.

articles.title: Donwald Declares No Siege of Calimshan Until the Ballots Are Counted

realm.name: Calimshan
realm.blurb: A proud desert realm in the south, ruled by stern clerics. It keeps a chokehold on the realm's busiest oil strait and holds grudges longer than most dragons.

articles.title: Donwald Declares No Siege of Calimshan Until the Ballots Are Counted

realm.name: Speaker Nancy Pelosis
realm.blurb: Longtime Speaker for the Blue Donkeys. Has strong opinions about Time Stop spells.

articles.title: Grand Vizier Mitch Casts Time Stop Spell Again

realm.name: Party of the Red Oliphant
realm.blurb: One of the two great parties of Waterdeep, marching under the banner of the Red Oliphant. Holds that the other party is ruining everything, a view the other party returns in full.

articles.title: Blue Donkeys Vow to Stall High Courts Vacancy Past Midterms

realm.name: Vaasa
realm.blurb: A broad land of wheat fields and stubborn people on Damara's border, which has spent several winters defending its lamp-oil works from Damaran ballistas.

articles.title: Donwald Declares Energy Ceasefire; Damara Skips the Memo

realm.name: Royal Revenue Service
realm.blurb: The tax collectors of the crown. They would like to see your looting permit for that dragon hoard.

articles.title: Royal Revenue Service Audits Adventurer Hoards

realm.name: the Coffers of Medicine & Succor
realm.blurb: The crown treasury that pays healers for tending the elderly and the poor.

articles.title: Healing Minister Opens Infirmary to Hunt for Curses in Pox Vials

realm.name: the Collegium of Michigloom
realm.blurb: A northern seat of learning that asks commoners every month how they feel about their purses. The answer is usually 'glum.'

articles.title: Coin Piles Hit Record Heights as Realm's Mood Sinks Below Dungeon Level

realm.name: Lodge 1000 of the Servitors' Guild-Union
realm.blurb: The Golden Coast's biggest union of state clerks and civil servants, some hundred thousand strong.

articles.title: Golden Coast Clerks Call First Strike; Margrave Rolls for Initiative

realm.name: the Noble Institutes of Healing
realm.blurb: The realm's great house of healing research, where scholars study ailments and cures.

articles.title: Healing Minister Opens Infirmary to Hunt for Curses in Pox Vials

realm.name: the Pentacle
realm.blurb: Five-sided fortress of Waterdeep's war ministry, where generals draw up siege plans on request.

articles.title: Donwald Declares No Siege of Calimshan Until the Ballots Are Counted

realm.name: the Homeland Watchtower
realm.blurb: Ministry that guards the realm's borders and gates, and which goes through spokespeople quickly.

articles.title: Ivory Keep Names New Herald for Her Unblemished Record of Agreeing

realm.name: the Bureau of Mounts & Wagons
realm.blurb: Where you register your wagon, license your horse and lose an afternoon.

articles.title: Golden Coast Clerks Call First Strike; Margrave Rolls for Initiative

realm.name: the Dwarven Jones Industrial Average
realm.blurb: An old index of thirty mighty forges and trading houses, still reckoned in points by dwarven accountants.

articles.title: Coin Piles Hit Record Heights as Realm's Mood Sinks Below Dungeon Level

realm.name: ChattyGolem-5.6
realm.blurb: The previous edition of OpenEye's talking golem, now mostly remembered for being slower to start talking than its successor.

articles.title: OpenEye's New Golem Answers in Illusions, Charts, and Tiny Catapults

realm.name: ChattyGolem-6 Sunforged
realm.blurb: The paid-tier edition of ChattyGolem-6, for those who tithe monthly.

articles.title: OpenEye's New Golem Answers in Illusions, Charts, and Tiny Catapults

realm.name: Bitgold
realm.blurb: Magic coins conjured from pure belief. Their value goes up, then down, then sideways, for reasons nobody can explain.

articles.title: Coin Piles Hit Record Heights as Realm's Mood Sinks Below Dungeon Level

realm.name: the Cleaveland Sentinels
realm.blurb: Cleaveland's batball club, stone-faced defenders of their home field, except when they aren't.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: the Stingmantas of Tampering Bay
realm.blurb: A thrifty batball club from a swampy southern bay that keeps beating richer clubs on a shoestring.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: the Starcallers of Hewston
realm.blurb: Hewston's batball club, star-gazers with a long memory for signals of every kind.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: Lost Angels
realm.blurb: Sprawling southern city of the Golden Coast, home to bards, illusionists and the worst carriage traffic in the realm.

articles.title: Golden Coast Clerks Call First Strike; Margrave Rolls for Initiative

realm.name: Chikraggo
realm.blurb: A windy lakeside trade city of Waterdeep split into a Southside and a Northside that agree on nothing, least of all batball.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: Cleaveland
realm.blurb: A lakeshore forge town of Waterdeep that takes its batball and its grudges seriously.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: Oakenland
realm.blurb: A hardworking bay city of the Golden Coast with a long memory and a longer picket line.

articles.title: Golden Coast Clerks Call First Strike; Margrave Rolls for Initiative

realm.name: ChattyGolem-6 Moonforged
realm.blurb: The free-tier edition of ChattyGolem-6. Same golem, smaller celestial body.

articles.title: OpenEye's New Golem Answers in Illusions, Charts, and Tiny Catapults

realm.name: Intelligent Illusions
realm.blurb: ChattyGolem's knack for conjuring its answers as glowing charts, forms, and tiny working tools.

articles.title: OpenEye's New Golem Answers in Illusions, Charts, and Tiny Catapults

realm.name: Sacramantle
realm.blurb: Seat of the Golden Coast's government, where the Margrave keeps his offices and wants everyone else to keep theirs.

articles.title: Golden Coast Clerks Call First Strike; Margrave Rolls for Initiative

realm.name: the Northside Owlbear Whelps
realm.blurb: Chikraggo's Northside batball club, much loved, much photographed, and often home early.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: the Golden Tower Scrying Company
realm.blurb: The High Lord's own scrying-and-message company, operator of the Truthscroll.

articles.title: Ivory Keep Names New Herald for Her Unblemished Record of Agreeing

realm.name: Oracle Echo Stones
realm.blurb: Household scrying stones that answer questions and, allegedly, listen to everything else.

articles.title: Oracle Echo Stones Accused of Listening to Private Conversations

realm.name: the News Maximus Crier
realm.blurb: A crier house that finds the Foxfire Tidings too restrained.

articles.title: Ivory Keep Names New Herald for Her Unblemished Record of Agreeing

realm.name: the Foxfire Tidings
realm.blurb: The realm's loudest town-crier house, friendly to the Red Oliphants and a common landing spot for former Keep officials.

articles.title: Ivory Keep Names New Herald for Her Unblemished Record of Agreeing

realm.name: Sean Berserk
realm.blurb: A Pale Stockings hurler of medium size and, allegedly, considerable stamina.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: Munetaka Muramagi
realm.blurb: A slugger from Kozakura who crossed the sea to hit balls for the Pale Stockings into places balls are not allowed.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: AirBnBugbear
realm.blurb: Rent-a-stranger's-lair booking guild. Listings occasionally come with a resident ghost not mentioned in the description.

articles.title: Haunted House Listed on AirBnBugbear Causes Guest Trauma

realm.name: MicroScroll
realm.blurb: The ancient guild of scroll-scribing software whose spell-ledgers run nearly every counting-house in Waterdeep.

articles.title: MicroScroll Barred From Hearth-Card Program: A Bold Pivot Toward Disruption

realm.name: Skipper Will Venerable
realm.blurb: The young skipper of the Pale Stockings, whose name sounds older than he is.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: Warder Bros. Diskovery
realm.blurb: Storied studio of talking cartoon beasts and brooding caped heroes, swallowed whole by Skytrance Consolidated.

articles.title: Skytrance Megamerger Closes, Bravely Rightsizes Hollowood's Adventuring Party

realm.name: Pallamount Pictures
realm.blurb: A venerable spectacle studio with a mountain on its banner, now folded into Skytrance Consolidated.

articles.title: Skytrance Megamerger Closes, Bravely Rightsizes Hollowood's Adventuring Party

realm.name: the Pale Stockings
realm.blurb: Chikraggo's Southside batball club, famous for losing 121 games in one season and then, two years later, refusing to stop winning.

articles.title: Pale Stockings, Laughingstock of 121 Losses, One Win From the Pennant Melee

realm.name: The Atlantean
realm.blurb: A venerable Waterdhavian journal of long essays and longer scoops, much read in the Keep and much resented there too.

articles.title: Donwald Declares No Siege of Calimshan Until the Ballots Are Counted

realm.name: Delvta Wyvern Lines
realm.blurb: A major wyvern carrier whose mounts eat staggering quantities of lamp oil.

articles.title: Coin Piles Hit Record Heights as Realm's Mood Sinks Below Dungeon Level

realm.name: the Potion & Provisions Authority
realm.blurb: The crown office that inspects the realm's potions, tonics and pantry goods, and publishes plain scrolls on how long a cold-box keeps the milk safe.

realm.name: the Golden Coast Office of Hirelings & Rosters
realm.blurb: The Golden Coast bureau that bargains with state workers, mostly by saying it is ready to bargain.

realm.name: the Silver & Platinum 500
realm.blurb: The realm's favorite tally of five hundred great guilds' share prices. When it rises, the Merchant Princes ring bells.

realm.name: Floridia Power & Lantern
realm.blurb: The lantern-and-lamp guild that keeps the hearths of Floridia lit, and is occasionally asked why they are not.
